description: Stay in your lane , get out of the way and let people merge. You’re not in a rush. #selflove #slowdown #relax
transcript: How we do, one thing is how we do everything, I am calm, I stay in my lane, I know the route that I'm taking. If I see that someone needs to merge or get over, I slow down and I let them get over. I move at a pace that is steady, I am not seeking anything, I'm allowing things to find its way to me. I do not need to rush this life. How I do one thing is how I do everything.
